episodes.title: Volume 1: The Devil
episodes.summary: A Los Angeles Sheriff's Deputy is slowly dragged into a dark underworld following a tragic shooting.

episodes.title: Volume 2: The Lovers
episodes.summary: In Mexico, Jesus learns of his family history in the cartel and meets an enigmatic young woman with her own agenda.

episodes.title: Volume 3: The Hermit
episodes.summary: Now a detective, Martin investigates a murder suspect who is not what he appears to be.

episodes.title: Volume 4: The Tower
episodes.summary: Viggo brings Martin under his wing, giving him a chance to prove himself.

episodes.title: Volume 5: The Fool
episodes.summary: Martin goes down a dark road while hunting two brothers in New Mexico.

episodes.title: Volume 6: The High Priestess
episodes.summary: Jesus returns to Los Angeles with a wife and a new agenda -- to reclaim his mother's empire.

episodes.title: Volume 7: The Magician
episodes.summary: Martin is caught in the middle of a gang war, as his bad decisions begin to catch up to him.

episodes.title: Volume 8: The Hanged Man
episodes.summary: Martin prepares to join Viggo, as Jesus's revenge plans are revealed.

episodes.title: Volume 9: The Empress
episodes.summary: As Yaritza's secret identity comes to light, Diana has a vision that gives her new hope.

episodes.title: Volume 10: The World
episodes.summary: The High Priestess of Death reigns supreme.
